source: Davin Pinto's supplied Strava activity screenshots and personal account, supplied 1 October 2026
method: Transcribed full-kilometre lap paces and heart rates. Five-kilometre block averages are arithmetic means of five rounded 1 km lap paces. Only the first 20 complete recorded kilometres are used in between-year block comparisons. Partial-lap distances are displayed rounded labels, not exact distances.
limits: The 2025 activity notes a GPS distance loss. Recorded kilometres are not exactly matched course locations across years. The screenshots do not establish weather, sensor type, training differences, fueling differences or an exact race-half split. No missing distance or lap is reconstructed; no cause of improvement is inferred. Badge best-effort improvements are not used as between-race comparisons.
